headline: Long NZDUSD at 0.5631 buys a +1.31% spike that is already fading: price sits 0.0003 above the day low, 0.0020 under the 0.5651 high, with 5m/15m momentum down and US CPI due.
argument:
The +1.31% move is a bounce off multi-year lows, not a trend change. Price is 0.5631 against a day range of 0.5628-0.5651, so it is already back at the bottom of the range, 0.0003 above the low. The 5m and 15m frames are both bearish: EMA9 below EMA21, price below SMA50, RSI 38.2 and 39.8, and the 15m MACD histogram is -5e-05. The only supportive frame is the 1h (RSI 54.8), but its MACD histogram is -0.000269 and has been negative two bars running, so that momentum is rolling over.

Overhead supply is close. The 50-bar high is 0.565068, and FXStreet's own forecast headline places the confluence at 0.5640-0.5645, just above entry. That leaves roughly 0.0009-0.0014 of room, about 1.3-2x the 1h ATR of 0.000685, before the first wall. Below, the 52-week low is 0.5529 and the pair made 24-year lows (Interest.co.nz, 8 Nov), so the bigger trend is down.

The fundamentals do not support a long. The RBNZ unexpectedly held on 28 Oct (snippet only), NZ faces weeks of political limbo after the election (investingLive, 8 Nov), and the US dollar is firm after payrolls (Forex Factory, 9 Nov). US CPI is a scheduled event inside the intraday window, and a hot print would hit this thin bounce. Buying into that with a stop that must be wider than normal noise is a poor bet.

plan_flaws: Room to the 0.5640-0.5645 confluence is only about 0.0009-0.0014 (roughly 1.3-2x the 1h ATR of 0.000685), so any realistic target is capped
A stop below the day low 0.5628 is only 0.0003 away, about 1x the 15m ATR of 0.000265 and well inside 1h noise; a stop wide enough to survive noise breaks the reward-to-risk
Entry is near the day low after a +1.31% move, so it is neither a breakout nor a clean pullback to support
US CPI is due inside the intraday window, so gap and whipsaw risk makes the stop unreliable
5m and 15m trends are bearish; only the 1h is bullish and its MACD histogram is falling
conditions_to_reconsider: Only worth taking after a 15m/1h close above 0.5651 (day high) with expanding volume, or a post-CPI dip that holds above 0.5628 with 15m EMA9 back above EMA21 and RSI above 50, giving a stop no tighter than about 1x the 1h ATR and at least 2R to the next resistance.
